WITH account_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency,
    AVG(t.amount) as avg_amount
  FROM account a
  INNER JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency
),
frequency_means AS (
  SELECT 
    frequency,
    AVG(avg_amount) as freq_mean
  FROM account_avgs
  GROUP BY frequency
)
SELECT 
  aa.account_id,
  aa.frequency,
  aa.avg_amount,
  CAST(aa.avg_amount AS REAL) / fm.freq_mean as ratio
FROM account_avgs aa
JOIN frequency_means fm ON aa.frequency = fm.frequency
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
